label: Matt 15:1
text: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

label: Matt 15:2
text: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

label: Matt 15:3
text:
He answered them,
“Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

label: Matt 15:4
text:
For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’
and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

label: Matt 15:5
text: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

label: Matt 15:6
text: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

label: Matt 15:7
text: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

label: Matt 15:8
Matt 15:9
text:
And in vain do they worship me,
teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

label: Matt 15:10
text:
He summoned the multitude, and said to them,
“Hear, and understand.

label: Matt 15:11
text: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

label: Matt 15:12
text: Then the disciples came, and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?”

label: Matt 15:13
text:
But he answered,
“Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

label: Matt 15:14
text: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

label: Matt 15:15
text: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

label: Matt 15:16
text:
So Jesus said,
“Do you also still not understand?

label: Matt 15:17
text: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?

label: Matt 15:18
text: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

label: Matt 15:19
text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

label: Matt 15:20
text: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

label: Matt 15:21
text: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

label: Matt 15:22
text: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

label: Matt 15:23
text:
But he answered her not a word.
His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

label: Matt 15:24
text:
But he answered,
“I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

label: Matt 15:25
text: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

label: Matt 15:26
text:
But he answered,
“It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

label: Matt 15:27
text: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

label: Matt 15:28
text:
Then Jesus answered her,
“Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

label: Matt 15:29
text: Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

label: Matt 15:30
text: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

label: Matt 15:31
text: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

label: Matt 15:32
text:
Jesus summoned his disciples and said,
“I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

label: Matt 15:33
text: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

label: Matt 15:34
text:
Jesus said to them,
“How many loaves do you have?”
They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

label: Matt 15:35
text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

label: Matt 15:36
text: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

label: Matt 15:37
text: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

label: Matt 15:38
text: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

label: Matt 15:39
text: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

variants.reading: Magadan (some Greek manuscripts, followed by the Revised Version)
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Magdala' article states that 'some Greek manuscripts give the name of the place as Magadan, and more recent translations (such as the Revised Version) follow this (Matthew 15:39)'. The article names no witness that is a manuscript node of this graph, so attested_by is left empty rather than inventing ids. The article also records Mark's parallel reading 'Dalmanutha', which a handful of manuscripts assimilate to Magdala or Magadan.
